name: fixture-login-flow-with-handle
description: Real example script: entry script with env interpolation, type/into, tap, handle branching on UI visibility, assertVisible, screenshot.
yaml:
format: atomyx/v1
appId: dev.atomyx.demo
name: Login flow — with OTP branching
description: Test login with handle for OTP vs direct dashboard
tags:
  - login
  - branching
env:
  email: otp@example.com
  password: secret123
  otp_code: "123456"
---
- launchApp
- sleep: 1000
- waitFor: "Sign in"

# Use type with into selector — ACTION_SET_TEXT targets the correct
# field via selector resolution instead of relying on focus state.
- type:
    into:
      role: text-field
      nth: 0
    text: ${email}
- type:
    into:
      role: text-field
      nth: 1
    text: ${password}
- tap: "Login"

# Handle: OTP screen or Dashboard. `when: visible` polls the tree so
# there's no need for an explicit sleep after tapping Login — the
# branch that lights up fires as soon as the transition renders.
- handle:
    - when:
        visible: "Enter OTP"
      do:
        - type:
            into:
              role: text-field
              nth: 0
            text: ${otp_code}
        - tap:
            label: "Verify"
            role: button
        - waitFor:
            text: "Dashboard"
            timeout: 10000
    - when:
        visible: "Dashboard"
      do:
        - screenshot: direct_login
    - otherwise: fail

- assertVisible: "Welcome"
- screenshot: login_complete
